# Cirth v0.8.0

Cirth v0.8.0 reworks the layout primitives so their names tell the truth:
`.grid` finally wraps, the old single-row behavior gets its own honest
name (`.row`), and `.container`/`.container-fluid` become a fluid,
permanent-gutter grid with a new `.breakout` escape hatch. **This is a
breaking change** — every page using `.grid` or `.container` reflows.

## Breaking changes

- **`.grid` now wraps; rename old single-row usages to `.row`.** Before
  this release, `.grid` was a single equal-column row that never wrapped
  (`minmax(0%, 1fr)` neutralizes `auto-fit`). That exact behavior is now
  `.row` — same markup, same class-for-class swap. `.grid` itself is a
  real, intrinsically responsive wrapping grid: `grid-template-columns:
  repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, var(--cirth-grid-min-column)), 1fr))`,
  new token `--cirth-grid-min-column` (default `12rem`). No more `md`
  breakpoint — `min()` collapses to one column on narrow viewports for
  free.
- **`.container`/`.container-fluid` repurposed.** The five stepped
  breakpoints (510px–1450px) are gone, replaced by one three-track CSS
  grid: two `--cirth-spacing` gutter tracks that never drop out, and a
  center track holding content — capped at new token
  `--cirth-container-max-width` (default `60rem`, a reading-friendly
  measure) for `.container`, uncapped for `.container-fluid`. The cap
  resizes continuously with the viewport instead of snapping at five
  2015-era breakpoints. If you relied on the old stepped widths, set
  `--cirth-container-max-width` to the value you need.
- **New `.breakout` utility.** Lets a direct child of `.container` — a
  wide table, image, or figure — fill the container's own box instead of
  stopping at the measure (`grid-column: 1 / -1`). Unlike the classic
  `width: 100vw; margin-inline: calc(50% - 50vw)` trick, it escapes only
  to the container's own edges, so it stays correct even when the
  container itself isn't centered in the viewport (a sidebar layout, for
  example), and it doesn't have the `100vw` trick's scrollbar-gutter
  overflow bug.
- The classless build's `body > header/main/footer` landmarks adopt the
  identical grid/token instead of their own separate stepped-width loop.

## Fixed

- The docs site's own layout shell combined `.container` with its
  sidebar/content/TOC grid on the same element, which the new `.container
  > * { grid-column: 2 }` rule silently collapsed to one column across
  every page. Fixed by separating the two grids onto nested elements.
- The `layout/overflow-auto` demo table wasn't keyboard-reachable once it
  started actually overflowing under the narrower container measure
  (`tabindex="0"` added, with a note on when it's needed).

See the [Changelog](https://github.com/cirthcss/cirth/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#080---2026-08-02)
for the complete, itemized list.
